summary: Develop climate rationale, investment logic and GCF proposal-readiness materials. Explore the course and plan your next step.
lede: Climate project development training helps public investment officers, utility managers and development-partner teams shape climate concepts into investment proposals. Participants build a climate-risk evidence register, map institutional roles, and connect intervention logic to Green Climate Fund investment criteria and results areas. They also screen environmental and social considerations and assemble a coached proposal-readiness package; funding-proposal requirements and related policies receive a guided overview, not full submission-level implementation.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who originate or review public and development-financed climate investments and need to connect climate evidence with funder requirements and institutional delivery.
modules: Theory of Change for GCF Concepts
GCF Proposal Readiness and Decision Briefing
prerequisites: Working familiarity with climate programmes, public investment, development finance or project preparation is recommended. No programming is required.
